description: Source code for controlling and configuring an N-Band equalizer module, including functions for getting parameters and capabilities, setting filters and coefficients, clearing filter history, and managing operating modes and transitions.

methods.name: LVEQNB_GetParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current equalizer parameters for a given instance.

methods.name: LVEQNB_GetCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves capabilities of the equalizer instance.

methods.name: LVEQNB_SetFilters
methods.description: Configures filter types for each band based on parameters.

methods.name: LVEQNB_SetCoefficients
methods.description: Calculates and sets filter coefficients for each band.

methods.name: LVEQNB_Control
methods.description: Sets or updates the module parameters and manages operating mode transitions.

methods.name: LVEQNB_BypassMixerCallBack
methods.description: Handles transition callbacks for bypass mode changes.
